descriptors.title: Prompt has no input schema
descriptors.description: Prompt input schemas are the TypeScript contract for prompt inputs, context joins, replay, eval cases, and devtools inspection.
descriptors.rationale: Prompt input schemas are the TypeScript contract for prompt inputs, context joins, replay, eval cases, and devtools inspection.
descriptors.impact: Untyped prompt inputs are harder to validate, replay, compare, and safely refactor as the prompt evolves.

fixes.title: Declare prompt input
fixes.description: Add an input schema to the prompt so calls, eval cases, and traces share one inspectable contract.

descriptors.title: Router has no default route
descriptors.description: Routers need an explicit default route so unknown classifier outputs remain observable and deterministic instead of failing or silently depending on adapter behavior.
descriptors.rationale: Routers need an explicit default route so unknown classifier outputs remain observable and deterministic instead of failing or silently depending on adapter behavior.
descriptors.impact: A classifier returning an unexpected key can produce confusing route decisions and incomplete route coverage in traces.

fixes.title: Add default route
fixes.description: Add a default entry to the router routes map and point it at the safest fallback model or policy.
